title: Make malformed Kimi permission-choice dismissal visible
outcome: A Kimi permission request dismissed because its choices cannot be interpreted leaves a useful visible diagnostic without restoring generic first-option approval.
acceptance: Malformed Kimi choices remain rejected/cancelled without fabricating an answer and produce a useful log or resolved transcript notice explaining the dismissal.
Behavioral coverage observes the diagnostic for invalid choices and confirms no pending generic approval and no selected answer are created.
